subject: Ambiguous abort of combined flush-test + 3GB live CAP1000 retry

findings.signalInterpretation: Node/V8 aborted with FATAL ERROR: Reached heap limit Allocation failed - JavaScript heap out of memory; pnpm reported exit code 134 (128+SIGABRT).

findings.rationale: No terminal session file records this spawn's exit_code/signal. /tmp/flush-test2.log contains only the TAP header ('TAP version 13') and was truncated at 15 bytes — the focused unit test never finished writing results, and no LIVE_EXIT / heap OOM / process-manager timeout line exists for the 3GB live half. Conversation continuity was lost mid-spawn ('spawn aborted'). Therefore this abort cannot be classified as OOM-kill, process-manager timeout, or successful completion; it is an undetermined agent/tool spawn interruption before independently verifiable process exit evidence.
